book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Maluko

content: Yesu jubola lijambu lu kutalikana
Yesu jaboka papu jajenda ku Yudea, mbaka kwii juku losi luku Yoludani. Nsambi wa bandu gunzendila kabee, najombi jaabola kabee ngati ebayobali.
Ndi Afalisayu bunzendila nu kulenga kundaluki, “Boo malagalaki gaka Sapanga gajetake mwanalomi kuntalika nhwana mundo?”
Yesu japwaaga, “Musa jumpekya malagalaki bole?”
Nabombi bapwagaa, “Musa jalagalakya mwanalomi juwesa kunhandakii nhanuwaki likalatasi lukutalikana.”
Yesu jaapwagila, “Musa jalagalakya malagalaki ge haga ndaba ngasemmboleka.
Lakini Sapanga hejaabomba bandu bakwanza, jwaabomba mwanalomi numbomba ngati Maandiku ga Sapi egapwaga.
Na hela mwanalomi jaaleka ahengo na amabu nukulombana na ahanu bake,
nabombi habeli haba bibia nhyega jimu. Na bombi ngaabele kabee ila nhyega jimu.
Ndienu gajugalombiki Sapanga mundu ngakuwesa kugabaganisa.”
Pabajingala kabee munyumba, banafunzi baki bundalukya kupete lijambu lela.
Najombi jaapwagila, “Jojwanndeka nhwanamundu nukunzukuu jongi, antendee ugoni nhwanu waki.
Ahelahe nu mbomba joandeka nndomi waki nukujenda kuulomu gongi najombi antendee ugoni nndomi waki.”
Yesu jaapengee bana asoku
Bandu bundetila Yesu bana asoku ili jaagusa, lakini banafunzi baki batenda kalakalii.
Yesu ejabona hela, jayoma nakaapwagi, “Mwaleka bana haba ahika kwango, wala mwaapengalee, ndaba Ukolongu waka Sapanga guhikiki ndaba ja bandu baabii ngati bana haba.
Numpwagi sakaka, mundu jokapi jwanga kujetake Ukolongu waka Sapanga ngati mwana nsoku, ngajwi jingii mu Ukolongu waka Sapanga.”
Ndipala, jaajopa bana bala, jaabekila maboku gaki nakaapenge.
Mundu jojabii na mali gingi
Yesu pajabia jutenda kuboka mundu jumwa anzombatakya nukun'gungamalii nukundaluki, “Mbola waamboni, ndendaboo nugupata womi wa masoba goa?”
Yesu japwaaga, “Ndaba jakii gungema nambone? Ngajojubii jwa amboni ila Sapanga kajika jaki.
Ugamanyi lee Malagalaki gaka Sapanga, ‘Witenda ugoni na wikoma na wijiiba na wikopake na wipwaga isoli na wajoannya ahengo baku na amabu baku.’ ”
Najombi japwaga, “Mbola, haga goa nagakamwi toka muukombu wango.”

Yesu andingaliya, nukumpala, nukumpwagi, “Sindu simwa kitei kupunguu kwaku. Gujenda ukalombisa kila sindu segubinaku, gwapekya bandu banga na sindu lupija lweni, nanagu wiibia nikikoku kunani kwaka Sapanga. Ndienu gwihika kumbwata.”
Pajajowana ganiaga, jasoka makili, jajenda koni jubii nu usungu, ndaba jabii na mali gingi na ngasijapai kupia sindu sokapi.
Yesu jalinga pandi yoha, nakwapwagi banafunzi baki, “Kunonwipi ngamaa mundu jwana mali gingi kundeke Sapanga julongua womi waki!”
Banafunzi balwehuki na malobi gaki. Yesu jaapwagila kabee, “Mwabanango, kunonwipi ngamaa kundeke Sapanga julongua womi waki!
Ngati ekunonwipi kinyama sebikikema ngamia kupeta mwilihotu la sindanu, na ahelahe kubonikana kunonwipi, mundu jwana hindu kundeke Sapanga julongua womi waki!”
Banafunzi baki basangia ngamaa nu kulaluana, “Henu nya jojwiwesa kulama?”
Yesu jalingaliya nakapwagi, “Kwa bandu ngakuwesikana, lakini kwaka Sapanga nga hela, ndaba kwaka Sapanga goa gawesikana.”
Petili ampwagila, “Linga! Natwe bo? Tukotwiki kila sindu, tugujengale we!”
Yesu japwaaga, “Numpwagi sakaka, mundu jokapi jojijilei nyumba au alongu baki au nndombu mundu au amabu au ahengo au bana au matui ndaba jaminee ni Lijambu la Amboni,
jwiipata mala mia muda gongo, nyumba na akaalongu naalombumundu na nyongoo na bana na matui pamu nukung'alika, na muda gogwihika jijopa womi wa masoba goka.
Lakini bandu bingi babilibona akolongu sajenu bibia asoku na babilibona asoku bibia akolongu.”
Yesu jupwaga mala jatatu lijambu lu kukuwa nu kuyoka kwaki

Ndienu, babii mwindela kujenda kunani ku Yelusalemu, na Yesu jwabiya jaalonguli. Banafunzi baki babii nikiholu, na bandu babunzengale munyuma batenda kujogopa. Yesu jaajukua kabee komi na habeli bala nukujendanabu pulutengo, nukutumbuli kaapwagi gagampitila.
Japwagila, “Nzogwana tujenda ku Yelusalemu. Na hoku Mwana waka Mundu bumpelika kwaka agolu akolongu na abola bamalagalaki, nabombi bantemua kunkoma nukunkabisi kwa bandu banga Ayaudi.
Nabombi bitenda kunkangasaki, banhunila imata, bandapula migwandu nukunkoma. Lakini elihika lisoba la tatu jwiitenda kuyoka.”
Kuloba kwaka Yakobu na Yohana
Yakobu na Yohana, bana baka Zebedayu, bunzendila Yesu nukumpwagi, “Mbola, tupala utuhengila sindu setuguloba.”
Yesu jalalukya, “Mpala nunhengila kike?”
Bumpwagila, “Utujetakya kutama jumwa upandi wa malele na jongi upandi wa mangega pagwitama pikiteu saku su Ukolongu nu ulumbi waku.”
Yesu jaapwagila, “Ngasemwikimanyi se nndoba! Boo, nhwesa lee kuhinakali kunywele nzipuli ukung'alika goninywelila, nuubatisu ukung'alika ngati ebimatisa nenga?”
Bombi bumpwagila, “Tuwesa.” Yesu jaapwagila, “Sakaka nhwesa kunywele nzipuli ukung'alika nukuhinakalii ubatisu ukung'alika ngati ebimatisa.
Ila bandu babiitama kwa malele au kwa mangega kwangu, nga lihengu langune kupanga. Ila napwasi jeheji biipata bahaguliwi na Sapanga.”
Banafunzi bangi bala babajoana ganiaga, batenda kwayome Yakobu na Yohana.
Ndienu, Yesu jaakema, nakapwagi, “Mmanyiki baaholale kuba akolongu babandu banga Ayaudi, baalongoo bandu babu kwa makili. Na akolongu behaba abii nu uwesu nkolongu kwa bandu babu.
Lakini kwinu kwikuba hela, ila jojipala kuba nkolongu kati jinu, jupalika jubia ntumisi wino.
Jojupala kuba nkolongu kupeta boa, jupalika jubia mtumisi wa boa.
Ndaba Mwana waka Mundu ngasejwahika kuntumakila, ila kwaatumikii bandu nukuboa womi waki ili kwaagombo bandu bingi.”
Yesu andamisa mundu jumu jwanga kulinga jobunkema Batilomayo

Ndienu, bahika ku Yeliko, najombi Yesu pajabii juhuma kumusi we hogu koni jubii na banafunzi baki pamu nu nsambi wa bandu. Mundu jumu jwanga kulinga, jobunkema Batilimayo, mwana waka Timayo, jojabii jutemi mulutengu jindela, jakaloba.
Pajajowana Yesu juku Nazaleti jabii jupeta papu, jatumbulya kujamalii, “Yesu, mwana waka Daudi, gumonila ikia!”
Bandu bingi bundakalya jutama kinunu, lakini jombi jaendalya kujamalii, “Mwana waka Daudi, gumonila ikia.”
Yesu jajema nukupwaga, “Munkema.” Ndienu bunkema jwanga kulinga we hoju nukumpwagi, “Wijogopa! Jema, jugukema.”
Najombi jalekala kutali gungobu gwaki, jahomba kunani, nukumpwata Yesu.
Yesu andalukiya, “Boo gupala nuguhengila kike?” Jwanga linga we jola ampwagila. “Mbola, nanoba nhwesa kulinga.”
Yesu ampwagila, “Jendaje, kuhobale kwaku kugulamisi.” Apalapa, mundu jwanga kulinga we jola jwawesa nukulinga, nukunzengale Yesu mwiindela.
